title: A regular safety can opener is easier and still safer...
text:
A regular safety can opener is easier and still safer.... [[VIDEOID:1b5c073647f0b0faa8c0d05b0ebd3029]] THE GOOD:
--------------
* Unique gadget you can showoff to guests. That's about all.

THE BAD:
------------
* Getting a smooth result is hit or miss. In my video, the result was pretty good. But in my photo, the result was pretty bad. I'm pretty sure a smooth cut is possible all the time once you get the knack down. A traditionally safety can opener is easier, and doesn't require achieving any type of knack.
* Having said that... what is the point in creating something that is already in existence? The point would be to improve on the product. Does this product improve on the traditional safety can opener? That would be an emphatic NO! The biggest flaw is the fact that this model cuts the entire silver top off the can. So even if you can achieve a smooth cut, the edge is razor thin because the smooth silver rim is also cut off. Something like this is not only easier, but it leaves the top rim: https://www.amazon.com/Smooth-Edge-Can-Opener-Replacement/dp/B077SJT9MZ/ref=sr_1_11?crid=UTVUOX2G87M&dchild=1&keywords=safety+can+opener&qid=1633913551&sprefix=safety+can+%2Caps%2C223&sr=8-11

I'm usually not this harsh on my reviews, but this product makes me scratch my head. 1-Star.
